localChanges: Cruisers, Battleships, Submarines, Carriers, Transports, Nuclear, Diplomats and Caravans no longer have a light-blue line down their right-hand side and along the bottom (closes #12).
If you've already imported your assets, import them again from the main menu with "Replace existing assets?" ticked to get the fixed sprites.

log: The `y: 177` `units/` row in SP257.PIC (cruiser … caravan) set no size, so it fell back to the 16×16 defaults and each sprite took in the 1px separator to its right and below. The separator colour (0,168,168) isn't the knock-out colour, so it showed as a light-blue line along the right and bottom edges (civ-clone/web-renderer#12).
